text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Wow! The tree leaves have all turned to
their fall
colors! They look so marvelous
swaying in the
wind. ♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Gracious, they really get your emotions
going,
don't they? It makes me feel kind
of lonesome...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Why would you feel that way?
These colors
are so marvelous to look
at! ☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That's true, but seeing them reminds me
that
winter's right around the corner.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't feel lonely with all this fun
in sight!
Look, just step on the leaves
like this...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Crunch, crunch! ♪ Crunchy, crunch! ♪
You'll hear
the most marvelous sound. ☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, I see. With your marvelous touch, I
suppose
you can find fun just about
anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's crunch them together!
Crunch,
crunch! ♪ Crunchy, crunch! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to pass. I'd rather leave them
intact for
the kiddies.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hm? This feeling... It brings back so
many
memories. It kind of... feels good.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! Fall leaves are truly
marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Now let's dive into this leaf pile! On the
count of
three! One, two...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You really startled me there... Then
again, you've
always been
unpredictable.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
They're so marvelous and pretty! ☆ So

marvelously nice to the touch! ★ I love
the
marvelous nature of fall! ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Can't help yourself, huh? You
blew my
pensive fall mood right away.
